rims.note: measured from the rim's orange paint over 37 sampled frames. Occlusion (foliage, net, blur) only SHORTENS a visible run, so the estimate is the upper plateau, not the median: p50=198 p75=226 p90=236 max=249; the 8 widest frames span x760..998 = 238px. Max sits only 11px above p90, so no ball merged with the rim in those frames. Method validated on clip 1, where it reproduced the filed rim within 2-3px.
